HOW IT WORKS

Plan individual and shared meals
Name each lane.
Add each person and one shared lane.
Place the meal.
Pick a day, a lane, and who shares it.
Mark the prep.
Leave a small prep task for later.
What this does not do

It does not store recipes, order groceries, score nutrition, or check allergens. It shows one weekly meal board on this device.
